purpose: H100/H200 proof run with full-vocabulary validation loss tracked at every eval.
optimizer: AdamW fused when CUDA supports it
tracked_metrics: full-vocabulary validation cross entropy over every validation token
gradient norm after unscale before clipping
notes: Training objective remains sampled+anchor for speed; validation is full vocabulary.
This config is intentionally wide and four layers deep to make better use of H100 tensor cores than a narrow eight-layer config.
Start with batch_size=4 on H100 80GB. On H200 141GB, try batch_size=8 after a 200-step smoke test.
